Line chart with two panels, titled 'Persistence and relative mobility by cohort'. Y-axis runs from 0.0 to 0.8 in 0.1 steps (no axis title). X-axis shows cohorts 1940, 1950, 1960, 1970, 1980. Left panel: 'Intergenerational Persistence (IGP)'. Right panel: 'Privilege (Bottom Half to Top Quartile)'. Legend (series): China, Indonesia, Lao PDR, Malaysia, Mongolia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam. Values are not printed; approximate readings (~) are below.

IGP panel:
- China: 1940 ~0.29, 1950 ~0.30, 1960 ~0.32, 1970 ~0.45, 1980 ~0.48
- Indonesia: 1940 ~0.57, 1950 ~0.55, 1960 ~0.63, 1970 ~0.49, 1980 ~0.42
- Lao PDR: 1950 ~0.55, 1960 ~0.56, 1970 ~0.47, 1980 ~0.39
- Malaysia: 1940 ~0.00, 1950 ~0.40, 1960 ~0.39, 1970 ~0.32, 1980 ~0.29
- Mongolia: 1940 ~0.14, 1950 ~0.22, 1960 ~0.19, 1970 ~0.15, 1980 ~0.24
- Philippines: 1940 ~0.32, 1950 ~0.30, 1960 ~0.21, 1970 ~0.32, 1980 ~0.15
- Vietnam: 1940 ~0.37, 1950 ~0.36, 1960 ~0.38, 1970 ~0.55, 1980 ~0.47

Privilege panel:
- Lao PDR: 1940 ~0.31, 1950 ~0.20, 1960 ~0.15, 1970 ~0.17, 1980 ~0.15
